notes.title: 4K and features - Major Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
🎉 [b]Virtual Presenter Room – Big Update to Version 1.1.0 is Here![/b] 🎉

We’re excited to announce the latest update for Virtual Presenter Room! Version 1.1.0 brings exciting features that give you even more control and flexibility. Check out the new tools that will elevate your presentation experience to the next level!

✨ [b]Highlights of Version 1.1.0:[/b]

🔸 [b]4K Output via NDI and Spout[/b]
Enjoy crystal-clear 4K presentations – now supported directly via NDI and Spout. Perfect for high-end streaming and professional presentations!

🔸 [b]External Control Window[/b]
Keep full control over your presentation without disturbing the main screen. With the new external control window, you can easily monitor and adjust your setup.

🔸 [b]Hard Cuts Mode[/b]
Switch between scenes without delay – ideal for quick presentations and dynamic transitions.

🔸 [b]Animated Camera Movements[/b]
Bring motion into your presentations! With new animated camera movements, you can create smooth presentations and dynamic angles to captivate your audience even more.

🔸 [b]NDI Support for Portrait Mode[/b]
NDI sources can now be displayed in portrait orientation within the room. Perfect for vertical content that’s optimized for mobile applications or social media presentations!
